description_en: The Haribhajana Phalcā is located at the south-western corner of an open square known as Capāḥ Phaḥ, opposite the Bālakumārī Temple. It is connected to Tāhā Phalcā towards the east.Users of the Phalcā have built a store-room on its south-eastern side. Devotees hold Lord Hari in great reverence, which is why this Phalcā bears the name Haribhajana Phalcā. The Phalcā is owned and looked after by the Bhagavānadyaḥ Guṭhī. Around 2000 CE, the Phalcā was rebuilt with concrete pillars and a flat concrete slab. Before the reconstruction, it had carved wooden pillars andjhĩgaṭītiled roof. Two of the pillars are now kept in Dampāche Phalcā (SUN4011). Only the brick masonry with decorative bricks (kasimvaḥandlibi) and the base stones of the original structure remain here. In 2014, a vehicle driving on the narrow street struck the Phalcā and greatly damaged it. A brick pillar was added to further support the upper slab.A statue of Padmapāṇi Lokeśvara has been placed in a niche of the southern wall. Inside the Phalcā, one can find a stone icon of Padmapāṇi or Matsyendranāth.
description_ne: नारायणको भजन गरिने फल्चा हुनाले यस फल्चाको नाम हरिभजन फल्चा रहनगएको हो । भगवानद्यः गुठीको स्वामित्वमा यो फल्चा रहेको छ । अहिले ढलान गरिए पनि पहिले यो फल्चामा झिँगटीको छाना राखी परम्परागत शैलीमै निर्माण गरी काठकै खम्बा हालिएको थियो । २० वर्ष अघि फल्चालाई भत्काई ढलान गरिएको थियो । ढलान गरेपछि पहिलेको परमपरागत फल्चाको टुँडालका दुईवटा कुँसलहरू (corner struts) दम्पाछेँ फल्चा(SUN4011)मा राखिएका छन् । पाँच वर्षपहिले मोटरले ठक्कर दिएपछि फल्चाको पश्चिमपट्टिको भागमा केही क्षति पुगेको थियो । विशेष गरी पश्चिमपट्टिको पिलरमा क्षति पुगेपछि इँटाको खम्बा बनाएर जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो । नारायणको भजन गरिने फल्चा भए पनि यहाँ पद्मपाणि लोकेश्वरको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । यहाँ कुनै अभिलेख नहुनाले फल्चाको निर्माण कहिले गरिएको थियो भन्न सकिँदैन ।

historical_events.event_description: The Phalcā was in a dilapidated condition. However, it is has a great ritual importance, and so local donations were collected so that it could be reconstructed.

historical_events.event_name: Damage as a result ofroad traffic
historical_events.event_description: A vehicle passing through the street struck the Phalcā on its western side and caused damage. Afterwards, a brick pillar was added to further support the upper slab.
